content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how to switch from a personalized site back to the standard [product_name] interface? Thank you. Best regards, [user_name]
Log off and then log in again, but make sure the option for "to customized sites" is not checked.

Thank you for your response! I now have another issue: when accessing the URL in Chrome, the customized page is entirely white with no navigation visible. I was hoping to reset the selection for customized pages by a different method to see if the standard page would be accessible. I tried using Internet Explorer as well, but encountered the same problem. The SD card is installed, formatted, and usable for copying the program. The device responds to ping commands. Do you know why I only see a blank page? Initially, I could access the customized page from the PC used to create it with [product_name], but not from other computers. To address this, I performed a factory reset and re-downloaded the program and [product_name]. Now, even the original PC shows the issue. Any suggestions on what might be wrong? Thank you.
Why did you create two threads for the same issue? [product_name] - pages not visible on other PCs.

Hello, based on your feedback, it seems both problems may share the same root cause. I initially started this thread to discuss switching off the personalized web site without accessing the device's URL. From what I understand, that's not possible, and I now have the white page problem. It's not always straightforward to decide how to organize topics. Initially, I thought the issues were unrelated, and combining them might have led to suggestions to split them instead. If you'd like, we can cross-reference the other thread. Regardless of thread organization, I'm mainly interested in resolving the issue with the white page.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble restoring the standard web interface after activating a customized site through the web editor. The personalized web page displays only a blank screen with no navigation, and reverting to the standard page is blocked by this persistent error. The problem occurs across different browsers and remains even after resetting the device.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a straightforward way to switch back to the standard web interface and consistent access to the customized web page from any PC or browser.
